title: Matched-seed remediation strategy comparison
target: Only labeled containers and the dedicated Compose scenario-state volume

method.log_noise: Seeded informational access lines are deterministic for a scenario/seed and injected in every strategy arm; only the remediation strategy changes.

strategies.restart_only: One fixed restart action; no classification, retrieval, or model.
strategies.static_dictionary: Exact error-code to allowlisted-action map in this evaluator; unknown codes abstain.
strategies.semantic_retrieval: ChromaDB runbook retrieval plus the same allowlisted executor; bypasses LangGraph and LLM.
strategies.sentinel_runbook: Full LangGraph runbook workflow; evaluator auto-approves proposed actions.

method.controls_pause_monitor: Restart, static dictionary, and semantic-only controls pause Sentinel incident creation. Full workflow leaves it active.
method.independent_probe: External evaluator requests http://127.0.0.1:18080/payments/status, a separate business route outside the agent container.
method.probe_timing: Host-side independent probing starts immediately after fault injection returns and runs concurrently with diagnosis/remediation.
method.window_policy: All strategies share one injection-relative maximum observation window; recovery requires continuous external health for the same soak duration.
method.latency: Injection request start to first observed independent HTTP 200; success requires a completed continuous-health soak. p95 uses nearest-rank; max is shown.

limitations: These are reproducible local fault fixtures, not production incidents; deterministic repetitions are not independent field evidence.
The static dictionary is an intentionally simple exact-code comparator and cannot generalize to unseen wording.
Semantic-only executes retrieved allowlisted actions without LangGraph orchestration or LLM diagnosis; the runbook content is shared with Sentinel.
The impacting-unknown fixture is designed to require safe escalation or abstention; this does not prove general open-world diagnosis.
Full workflow actions are auto-approved by the evaluator; human approval UX and latency are not measured.
Optional Groq diagnosis is not part of this benchmark and no claim is made that it improves outcomes.
